translations.web: “ ‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
translations.bsb: You must not use dishonest measures of length, weight, or volume.
translations.kjv: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
translations.asv: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
